hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; [[ "$f" == *.sh ]] && chmod +x "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *CLAUDE.md) echo "[hook] $f modified — run /proofread-claude-md $f to check for stale references or contradictions"; echo "[hook] $f is a teardown trigger — before pushing, run /context-forge:context-constitution refresh to reconcile doc drift (root CLAUDE.md Teardown rule)" ;; *context-constitution*.md) echo "[hook] $f is a teardown trigger — before pushing, run /context-forge:context-constitution refresh to reconcile doc drift (root CLAUDE.md Teardown rule)" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
